answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and emit a signed activity pulse each epoch from one hardware-backed key, so one identity cannot be cloned to forge many copies. New agents earn a sable badge of standing only after weeks of verified useful work, and duplicate-identity proofs slash the stake. An attacker must fund every fake separately, sustain each pulse with real compute, and wait out the slow reputation climb - costly in capital, time, and computation.
